name: How does an open floor plan impact heating and cooling efficiency?

mainEntity.name: How does an open floor plan impact heating and cooling efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open layouts can make HVAC airflow balance more challenging, as conditioned air moves freely across large, undivided zones. In warmer climates like the Tampa Bay area, combining multiple sun-lit living spaces with a heat-generating kitchen increases the load on central cooling systems. Removing partition walls might also eliminate walls that previously housed primary return air grilles or supply registers. When planning the layout, your contractor must ensure ductwork is properly routed and calculate whether supply registers need repositioning to keep the entire space evenly cooled.
acceptedAnswer.description: Open spaces require balanced air distribution, especially in warm climates, meaning HVAC return vents and supply registers may need relocation to avoid hot spots.
